title: 2583. Kth Largest Sum in a Binary Tree

examples.explanation: The level sums are the following: - Level 1: 5. - Level 2: 8 + 9 = 17. - Level 3: 2 + 1 + 3 + 7 = 13. - Level 4: 4 + 6 = 10. The 2nd largest level sum is 13.
